easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with power less than or equal to the creature you intend to donate.
description:
Cast Spawnbroker by paying {2}{U}.
When Spawnbroker enters, it triggers, exchanging control of a creature an opponent controls with equal or lesser power and Altanak.
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying {1}{B}.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, targeting Altanak.
Altanak's second ability triggers, causing its controller to draw a card.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, targeting Altanak.
Repeat from step 5 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.
